title: one visibleWhen scope builder: the page:tabs badge mirrors SchemaRenderer's private configEvaluationScope (follow-up of objectui#12987)
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from objectui#12987's dev report (`6255043066`, out-of-scope finding 1), at that card's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What
- `@object-ui/react`'s `SchemaRenderer` builds a node's `visibleWhen` evaluation scope in the module-private `configEvaluationScope` (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`).
- objectui#12987 (PR #12991) made the `page:tabs` derived badge read the same `visibleWhen` gates. Because the builder is private, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` mirrors its four roots inline: the ambient predicate scope, `current_user` aliased to `user`, `record` only when a row is bound, and `page` variables.
- Real-`SchemaRenderer` pins in PR #12991 hold the two in step for `record.*`, but there are now two spellings of one scope rule. A root added to one is silently missing from the other.

## Wanted
One scope builder: export it from `@object-ui/react` (or a shared module both packages already depend on) and call it from both `SchemaRenderer` and the `page:tabs` count, retiring the mirror. If it is exported from `@object-ui/react`, that widens a published surface (`Clause-②: yes`, a contract review).

## Done when
`containers.tsx` builds no scope of its own; both readers call the one builder; the #12987 pins stay green.
